items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Duke Ellington in relation to other musicians (Tom Whaley, Elmer Snowden), but the interviewee (Benny Waters) does not mention Duke Ellington or indicate any personal connection.

ctx.x: I said, you said Black and White at one point and then you said Lamb's Club. Was -
No, I'm wrong. Lamb's Club, I worked with Tom Whaley, yeah. That was Tom Whaley, the same Tom Whaley that used to work with Duke Ellington -
